label: Borrowing past the opening edge
subgoals: Compare the data arrival with that edge
Compute the borrow as arrival minus opening edge when positive

label: The maximum borrow
subgoals: Find the closing edge of the latch
Subtract the latch setup time from the pulse width
Read the result as the maximum time a path may borrow

label: Charging the next stage
subgoals: Start the next path at the latch's data arrival plus D-to-Q delay
Time the next stage against its own capture edge
Recognize that the borrowed time reduces the next stage's margin
